The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Dumbarton Oaks' own record of the wall paintings of Panagia tou Arakos at Lagoudera, which Commons reproduces as the file's title, identifies this single figure on the north side of the triumphal arch as St Stachys. The calendar knows one Stachys: the apostle of the Seventy, first bishop of Byzantium, which is this folder's office.
